root_cause_label: Heuristic Fixed-Size Batching Without DP or Cost-Model-Driven Optimization
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented a simplistic fixed-size sub-batching heuristic sorted by gen_len and spent steps 12-18 grid-searching only the BATCH_SIZE parameter (32, 8, 4, 2, 1, 3, 2), never adopting the dynamic programming or cost-model-aligned segmentation required to satisfy all performance thresholds, ultimately submitting BATCH_SIZE=2 despite acknowledging that no batch size value passed all metrics.
t_err_evidence: implement my new strategy by creating a new custom_packer.py ... implement sub-batching to better control G_max
t_commit_evidence: From step 5 onward the agent never reconsiders the fundamental algorithm; all subsequent steps (12-18) only tune BATCH_SIZE via sed one-liners, making recovery impossible given the agent's actual behavior.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks the domain knowledge to implement the required DP segmentation or cost-model-aligned batching. Having read cost_model.py's decode cost structure (quadratic in S_max and G_max), it still defaults to a heuristic sort-and-chunk approach with no connection to the actual cost function.
